scenes.headline: Driver Ya Maalik?
scenes.sub: Woh nahi jaanti... ab khel shuru hoga.
scenes.vo: Mall ke entrance par, Rohan apni phati-purani driver uniform mein gaadi rokta hai. Engine ki thandi ho chuki awaaz, aur uski haanfti saansein... dono ek jaisi theen. Uski saans abhi bhi theek se nahi aayi thi... Jab Sanjana Ahuja, apni chamchamati heels ki awaaz karte hue gaadi se utarti hai, phone par kisi ko lecture dete hue. Uski awaaz parking mein goonj rahi thi. 'Tumne sunn na band kar diya hai kya, Rohan? Meri car kharab ho rahi hai! Engine awaaz kar raha hai! Aur yeh tumhari t-shirt? Ek driver bhi itni gandi t-shirt nahi pehenta! Kya tumhe thodi bhi tameez nahi hai?' Rohan ne bas chupchaap apni mutthi bheench li, uske nakhoon uski hatheliyon mein chubhne lage. Uski aankhon mein ek pal ke liye aag chamki, jo usne turant daba di. Kyunki sirf woh jaanta tha — jis ladke ko yeh ladki aise insult kar rahi hai, jiski aukat par sawaal utha rahi hai, wahi iss sheher ki sabse badi company ka maalik hai. Aur aaj... woh ek naya khel shuru karne wala tha, jiska anjaam Sanjana soch bhi nahi sakti thi.

scenes.heading: Gaadi Aur Driver
scenes.vo: Sanjana ke chehre par ghuroor tha, uski naak hamesha oonchi rehti thi. Woh phone par badi-badi baatein kar rahi thi, jaise Rohan wahan maujood hi na ho, jaise woh bas ek bejaan cheez ho. Usne ek pal ke liye Rohan ko ghoora, uski najrein Rohan ke gande kapdon par theen, phir apni najrein ghumali, jaise uski shakal dekhna bhi waqt barbaad karna ho. Rohan ka gale se pani nahi utra. Usne ek gehri saans li, apni nazrein zameen par gadhaye rakhi, uske kaano mein Sanjana ke teekhe bol abhi bhi goonj rahe the. Uske dimaag mein ek hi baat thi... kab tak? Kab tak woh yeh sab sahega? Kab tak yeh jhoothi izzat ka naatak chalega?

scenes.heading: Teekhe Bol
scenes.vo: Sanjana ne apna phone kaat diya, uski aankhon mein gussa aur beizzati saaf jhalak rahi thi. Uski aankhein seedhi Rohan par theen, jaise woh usse apni galti ka zimmedaar maan rahi ho. 'Jao, coffee leke aao. Meri meeting hai,' Sanjana ne car keys uski taraf uchhal di. Keys seedhe zameen par giri, theek uske pairon ke paas, ek halki si 'khat' ki awaaz ke saath. Sanjana ne ek pal ke liye bhi intezaar nahi kiya ki Rohan unhe uthaye.

scenes.heading: Chabi Ka Raaz
scenes.vo: Rohan ne ek pal bhi bina deri kiye, chupchaap jhuk kar chaabiyan utha lee. Usne unhe apni hatheli mein bheench liya. Uski ungliyon ne halka sa pressure dala, uske haath mein chhipi ek aur chaabi par... ek chamchamati, sleek, silver Ferrari ki chaabi. Woh chaabi, jo Sanjana ki 'kharaab' car se kahi zyada keemti thi. Ek invisible current uski body se guzra, uske iraade aur mazboot ho gaye. Yeh toh bas shuruat thi.

scenes.heading: CEO Ki Pehchaan
scenes.vo: Sanjana andar mall ki taraf badh gayi, bina ek baar bhi peeche mudkar dekhe, jaise Rohan wahan tha hi nahi. Rohan ne tab tak uski taraf dekha jab tak woh dikhna band nahi ho gayi, jab tak Sanjana ki chhoti si figure mall ke andar ghayab nahi ho gayi. Poora parking area ab khaali tha, bas Rohan aur uski purani car wahan the. Rohan ne apni pocket se ek sleek, black, latest model ka phone nikala. Normal drivers ke paas aise phone nahi hote. Usne bina dekhe ek number dial kiya, uski ungliyan jaise apne aap chal rahi theen.

scenes.heading: Ahuja Ka Sach
scenes.vo: 'Hello, Mr. Mehta? Aapki report aayi hai. Ahuja Industries ka valuation final ho gaya hai na?' Rohan ki awaaz ab pehle jaisi sehmi hui, dabbi hui nahi thi. Uski awaaz mein command thi, ek adesh tha, jaise woh kisi bade empire ka maalik ho. 'Good. Toh prepare rahiye. Aaj ek naya chapter shuru hone wala hai. Ahuja Industries ke liye... aur Sanjana Ahuja ke liye bhi.'

scenes.heading: Muskuraahat Ka Matlab
scenes.vo: Woh phone par baat karta hua apni purani gaadi ki taraf badha, uske kadam mein ek alag hi garv tha, jo kuch der pehle tak chhipa hua tha. Uske chehre par ek halki muskaan thi... ek aisi muskaan jo nafrat, revenge aur ek gehri planning ki kahani keh rahi thi. Usne apni car ka darwaza khola aur andar baith gaya, lekin uski aankhein abhi bhi Sanjana ke peeche thi, jo mall ke gate tak pahunch chuki thi. Woh uske har kadam par nazar rakh raha tha. Shayad yeh khel abhi aur dilchasp hone wala tha.

scenes.heading: Sanjana Ki Musibat
scenes.vo: Sanjana andar jaate hi, uska phone ek baar phir zor se bajta hai. Woh haanfte hue apne designer bag se phone nikalne ki koshish karti hai, jaldi-jaldi mein uska haath slip ho jaata hai. Uska Gucci ka bag uske haath se chhoot kar seedhe neeche, ek bade se paani ke puddle mein gir gaya. 'Oh My God!' Uska mooh khula reh gaya, aankhein badi ho gayeen. Poora bag geela ho chuka tha, uske andar ke documents, make-up, sab kuch paani mein doob chuka tha.

scenes.heading: Madad Ke Liye Awaaz
scenes.vo: Sanjana ne ghabrahat mein aas-paas dekha. Koi nahi tha, parking ab bilkul khaali ho chuki thi. Usne Rohan ki car ki taraf dekha. Usne zor se awaaz di, uski awaaz mein panic tha, gusse ke saath thodi si bechani bhi thi. 'Rohan! Rohan! Kahaan mar gaye?! Mera bag uthao! Jaldi!' Usne Rohan ko awaaz di, jaise woh uska personal naukar ho, uski awaaz mein wohi ghuroor ab bhi tha, chahe woh kitni bhi mushibat mein ho.

scenes.headline: Rohan ka agla kadam kya hoga?
scenes.vo: Rohan ne apni car ke andar se Sanjana ko dekha, uski aankhon mein ab bhi woh ghuroor tha, chahe woh kitni bhi mushibat mein ho. Phir usne neeche paani se bhare designer bag ko dekha, jo ab tak aadha doob chuka tha. Ek gehri saans usne andar li... jaise woh koi bada faisla lene wala ho, jaise yeh uske plan ka agla kadam ho, jise woh ab poora karne wala tha. Part 2 miss mat karna — subscribe kar lo abhi.
